meta.note: Signals ranked by how unusual they are against their own history (score). Effect: supports / weighs on prices, risk, watch.

lead: Supply grows +6 % in 2026 across the seven basins and +0.1 % in 2027. Chile is the main source of change: a record El Niño, a slowing harvest and fewer big fish. Norway carries the growth with heavier fish and more 6 kg+. Imports grow fastest in Japan, Brazil, UK; USA and Israel are flat or down.

signals.title: Extreme El Niño, warm Chilean water
signals.text: Niño 3.4 index (week of 2026-10-28); Chilean sea +1.0 to +2.9 °C vs normal in Oct. NOAA: El Niño continues to strengthen, with a strong-to-very strong El Niño likely through January-March 2027 (remaining greater than an 83% chance).

signals.title: Chlorophyll above every recent year
signals.text: Chile · Aysén fjords: 3.94 mg/m³ against 0.64 usually and 0.83 at most in the same weeks of the last 3 years (satellite, 2026-10-11 to 2026-10-24) — only 3 reference years, but at least twice the highest of them. It measures how much algae there is, not toxicity: a sign to watch, not a bloom.

signals.title: Sea lice: most farms flagged since 2025
signals.text: listed as high-dissemination sites in 2026 Q3 (31 to 49 in the other quarters since 2025); earlier years ran higher (about 70–85 cases a quarter in 2018–2019; no figures found for 2022–2024).

signals.title: Atlantic harvest slowing
signals.text: Jan–Sep on a year earlier, but month by month: Jul +3 %, Aug −6 %, Sep −2 %.

signals.title: More 6 kg+ than last year in Oct
signals.text: of the harvest in 6 kg+ (13.1 % a year earlier), adjusted with harvest-boat visits: zone 13 42 → 33 %, zone 9 13 → 19 %.

signals.title: Fewer big fish exported in the last 6 months
signals.text: share of 6 kg+ in whole Atlantic exports vs a year earlier (Sep 2026: 45 % vs 50 %). FOB price of 6 kg+ +16 % over the last 3 months (7.39 $/kg).

signals.title: Record harvest, heavier fish
signals.text: live weight over the 12 months to Sep 2026 (+5.7 %); harvest weight 4.96 kg (4.70 a year earlier).

signals.title: Florfenicol: decision pending
signals.text: Not re-authorised yet — 2 applications before the APVMA, decision on the industry's permit expected late November

signals.title: Norwegian export price below last year
signals.text: fresh salmon, week 44 (80.5 a year earlier, −7 %); export volume since January +13 %.

agenda.t: NOAA El Niño bulletin (strong-to-very strong El Niño expected through January–March 2027)
Norwegian biomass register for Oct (around the 20th)
Review: big-fish forecasts against the October register (harvest-boat method, first test on an unseen month)
APVMA decision expected on Salmon Tasmania's florfenicol emergency permit
Chile: critical El Niño period for algal blooms starts (Sernapesca); preventive algae emergency until 30 Jun 2027
Q4 trading updates: Bakkafrost, Mowi, Lerøy
